title: EVIDENT: Routing MLLM Adaptation through Entity-Grounded Visual Evidence for Cross-Domain Video Temporal Grounding

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding
task_scope.why_in_or_out: The task explicitly localizes query-relevant temporal moments or highlights.

evidence.quote: # Abstract Fine-tuning MLLMs for Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) often improves in-domain performance but degrades sharply under domain shift.

background_setup.summary: # Introduction Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) requires localizing the temporal extent of an event described by a natural language query in an untrimmed video.

evidence.quote: # Introduction Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) requires localizing the temporal extent of an event described by a natural language query in an untrimmed video.

background_setup.summary: While the task has been studied extensively with specialist temporal localization models such as DETR-based architectures , Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently emerged as a compelling alternative .

evidence.quote: While the task has been studied extensively with specialist temporal localization models such as DETR-based architectures [22, 35, 29, 42], Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently emerged as a compelling alternative [15, 40, 11, 44, 33, 51].

prior_work_summary.summary: Unlike prior works that re-run instruction tuning to reshape MLLM representations into an entity-level form, our adapter design enables VTG learning grounded in entity-based visual representations at minimal cost.

evidence.quote: Unlike prior works [46, 7, 24] that re-run instruction tuning to reshape MLLM representations into an entity-level form, our adapter design enables VTG learning grounded in entity-based visual representations at minimal cost.
